guarantees.text: reads values with `JSON.parse` and writes them with `JSON.stringify` through the storage the getter returns
the getter is called only when the storage is first accessed, not when `createJSONStorage` is called
the state is written to the storage under the key `name`
the stored value holds the state and the `version`
without `storage`, uses `createJSONStorage` over `localStorage`
with `partialize`, only the state it returns is persisted
a stored state whose version differs from `version` is not used as is
when the versions differ, `migrate` is called with the persisted state and its version, and its result is used
without `merge`, the persisted state is shallow-merged into the current state on rehydration
`skipHydration` defaults to false; when true, the state is not rehydrated on initialisation until `rehydrate` is called
`onRehydrateStorage` is called before rehydration, and the function it returns is called after it
returns a store exposing `setState`, `getState`, `getInitialState` and `subscribe`
`getState` and `getInitialState` return the state the state creator returned, before any update
`setState` with an object shallow-merges it into the current state by default
`setState` with `replace` true replaces the state with the given one
`setState` with a function calls it with the current state and merges what it returns
a listener passed to `subscribe` is called whenever the state updates, and the function `subscribe` returns removes it
for primitive values returns true when they are the same value and false otherwise, like `Object.is`
for two objects returns true when they have the same top-level keys and each top-level value is the same by reference
returns false when a top-level value is a different object with equal contents
returns false when the two objects have different prototypes
for two Sets returns true when they hold the same entries
for two Maps returns true when they hold the same keys mapped to the same values
